Metabolic Intelligence: Budget-Native Compute from Tag to Campus

Metabolic Intelligence gives computers a strict energy budget before they act—from a freezing coin-battery food tag to a hundred-megawatt campus.

[8-Yr Coin-Cell Schedule · 100% Cold Alerts Saved]

1/3 Give a computer a strict energy budget upfront, and design it to deliver the best verified answer inside that limit.

2/3 A food-freshness sensor tag can budget a coin battery for eight years and drop routine chatter in freezing cargo so critical alerts survive.

3/3 At the other extreme, a data center can follow power-grid caps by pausing flexible jobs and matching human reading speed.
